name: 3W Clinic Collagen Retinol Ball Eye Serum 30ml | Korea
description:
3W Clinic Collagen Retinol Eye Ball Serum is a serum-massage for the area around the eyes with collagen and retinol, which is able to moisturize and whiten the skin, besides smoothing out wrinkles. Due to the fact that the serum is enriched with various vitamins, collagen and retinol, it effectively nourishes the skin, and no matter how sensitive it is, the serum does not cause irritation on it. Collagen slows down the aging process by improving skin tone and smoothing out wrinkles. In addition, collagen restores the protective and regenerative properties of the epidermis, which is especially important for the eye area. Retinol also improves the texture, tone and relief of the skin. And due to the fact that the composition contains collagen, the effect of rejuvenation is enhanced several times. Moreover, retinoids help retain moisture in the cells, as well as remove age spots. Ball massagers relieve stress from the skin and smooth wrinkles around the eyes. They also improve blood circulation and help the serum to be absorbed. 

Ingredients: 

Purified water, glycerin, butylene glycol, niacinamide, carbomer, mineral oil, cetyl alcohol, stearyl alcohol, myristyl alcohol, lauryl alcohol, glyceryl stearate, glyceryl stearate lactate, PEG- 100 Stearate, Beeswax, Polybate 20, Dimethicone, Triethanolamine, Hydrolyzed Collagen (1,000ppm), Adenosine, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Methyl Methacrylate Crosspolymer, Retinol ( 1,000 ppb), Hydrogenated Lecithin, Cholesterol, BHT, Tocopheryl Acetate, Mung Bean Seed Extract, BHA, Oat Flour Extract, Peppermint Leaf Extract, Matricaria Flower Extract, Rosemary Leaf Extract, Fragrance, Benzyl Alcohol, Sheet Ral, Geraniol, Farnesol, Linalool, Citronellol, Hexylcinnamal, Limonene, Phenoxyethanol.
